newsitem.title: DENMARK: France Telecom wants 20 pct of Danish mobile market.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom wants 20 pct of Danish mobile market.

text.p: New Danish tele-operator Mobilix, which is to steer the mobile telephony activities of France Telecom in Denmark, said on Wednesday it was aiming for a 20 percent share of the local mobile telephone market.
"Our aim is to gain at least 20 percent of Danish mobile phone customers by making it cheaper and easier for people to use mobile phones in Denmark," Mobilix said in a statement.
It said it planned to invest 1.1 billion crowns over the next decade in Denmark on mobile telephony, creating 500 new jobs in the industry.
Earlier France Telecom Mobile was one of four successful bidders awarded Danish new DCS-1800 mobile telephone licenses by Denmark's National Telecom Agency.
The leading players in the field include market leader Tele Danmark and Sonofon.
